locations.note: Fenton escapes the Triads and investigates a missing mapmaker across Hong Kong's nightclub, streets, and harbor.
The prologue and later chapters take Fenton to a monastery in Tibet and on a mountain expedition to the hidden Khembalung Valley.
Fenton searches Marrakesh for Professor Hayes, visiting the bazaar, gendarmerie, and an oasis outside the city.
Fenton searches Nazi sites in Berlin, including the Brandenburg Gate area, an Olympic stadium, and a museum.
Fenton infiltrates Wewelsburg Castle to recover the Piri Reis map from its crypt.
Fenton searches an Indian village, the jungle and a temple for another artifact.

routes.name: Fenton's search
routes.note: From the Hong Kong airport over Tibet, Marrakesh, Berlin and Wewelsburg to India, and back into the mountains for Shambala.
